definitions.explanation: Prefix attached to a noun to mean 'the entire' or 'all of'. Common in formal and journalistic vocabulary expressing comprehensive scope.

examples.japanese: {全|ぜん}⟦{国民|こくみん}→国民：02757_kokumin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{呼|よ}びかける→呼びかける：06480_yobikakeru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{全|ぜん}⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{半額|はんがく}→半額：09546_hangaku⟧になっている。
examples.english: At this shop all products are half price.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今回|こんかい}→今回：01409_konkai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{改革|かいかく}→改革：04815_kaikaku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{全|ぜん}⟦{社員|しゃいん}→社員：03065_shain⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{働|はたら}き{方|かた}→働き方：25439_hatarakikata⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: This reform will affect the working style of all employees.

notes:
Prefix expressing totality, attached to nouns to mean 'all' or 'entire'. Most often appears in compound nouns of Sino-Japanese origin and in formal or written contexts.

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{全|ぜん}{国|こく}→全国：03311_zenkoku⟧: the whole country
- ⟦{全|ぜん}{員|いん}→全員：03310_zenin⟧: all members; everyone
- ⟦{全|ぜん}{世界|せかい}→全世界：22064_zensekai⟧: the whole world
- {全|ぜん}⟦{社員|しゃいん}→社員：03065_shain⟧: all employees
- {全|ぜん}⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧: all products
- ⟦{全|ぜん}{校|こう}→全校：28166_zenkou⟧: the whole school
- {全|ぜん}⟦{種類|しゅるい}→種類：01560_shurui⟧: all kinds

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{全部|ぜんぶ}→全部：02888_zenbu⟧: all; the whole — stand-alone noun/adverb
- ⟦{総|そう}→総〜：03958_sou⟧〜: total; gross — emphasizes the aggregate sum (⟦{総|そう}→総〜：03958_sou⟧{売|う}り{上|あ}げ total sales)
- ⟦{皆|みな}→皆：01810_mina⟧: everyone — refers specifically to people, conversational
